content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-316. - Licensing and reporting procedures.
content.summary:

      …

faqs.a:
(a)
Every owner, operator, or person who has the duty to collect and remit the tax imposed
               pursuant to this article shall obtain a business license to collect admissions tax
               and report the collection of admissions taxes on forms prescribed by the finance director
               and remit admissions tax moneys to the city within the following time periods:
(1)
For regular continuing or recurring events, including, without limitation, showing
               films in motion picture theaters, the admissions tax shall be remitted to the city
               on or before the 20th day of the month for the preceding month; and
(2)
For single, noncontinuing or nonrecurring events, including, without limitation, a
               single performance of a concert, the admissions tax shall be remitted within five
               calendar days of such performance or event, unless the finance director grants a longer
               period of time.
(b)
The city clerk shall issue a business license at no charge to any person upon the
               filing of an application, which shall be in a form prescribed by the finance director.
               Such business license shall be conspicuously posted in the place of business or in
               the facility for which it is issued. Any such license issued for a regularly continuing
               or recurring performance or event shall be in effect until revoked in the manner prescribed
               in this article; and any such license issued for a single, noncontinuing or nonrecurring
               performance or event shall expire upon completion of such performance or event or
               at such later time as designated by the city clerk on the business license.
(c)
Whenever a business entity that holds a business license as provided by this article
               is sold, purchased, or otherwise transferred, so that the ownership interest of the
               purchaser or seller changes in any respect, the purchaser shall obtain a new business
               license.
(d)
A business license may be suspended or revoked for the reasons and in the manner prescribed
               for business licenses in
section 98-65
.
(e)
The finance director may require a deposit of an amount of money equal to a reasonable
               estimate of the admissions tax to be derived from a single, noncontinuing or nonrecurring
               event as a condition of issuance of a business license by the city clerk.
(Code 1981, § 31-135; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;
Ord. No. 4548, § 2, 5-2-2016
)
